name: Dynamic NeRF
definition: A variation of NeRF designed to operate on dynamic 3D objects by explicitly considering rigid and non-rigid motion of the target. It constructs a 3D model based on a camera moving around the object.
summary: Dynamic NeRF extends static NeRF to model dynamic 3D objects by treating time as an explicit input and using deformation fields to map canonical representations to deformed scenes.
